item.title: CHIPS Alliance at Latch-Up 2026
item.description: CHIPS Alliance was proud to sponsor Latch-Up 2026, held May 1-3, 2026, in Waterloo, Ontario, Canada. Organized by the FOSSi Foundation, Latch-Up is a weekend of presentations and networking dedicated to free and open source silicon. Designed for the open source digital design community, the event brings together engineers, developers, and contributors to share technical work and connect across the ecosystem. It is the North American counterpart of the European open silicon conference with a 14-year history, ORCONF, also organized by FOSSi, which CHIPS will be joining and sponsoring later this year.
